rationale: PINS the review-wave G2 gap (java JAO1 parity): @Override is a check, not a requirement — Sub.greet redeclares Base.greet with the identical signature and no annotation, so it overrides at exact-in-file confidence. Overloads never pair: Sub.nth(int, Object) against Base.nth(int) is not an override. Private same-signature members never pair (helper).
